title: Configuration baseline
subtitle: Record the current state of selected resources and see later what has drifted. Checks only read the cluster; nothing is applied or fixed automatically.
empty: No baselines yet. Create one to record the current configuration.
noManage: Creating baselines requires the “Manage configuration baselines” permission.
confirmDelete: Delete baseline “{name}” with all its versions, exceptions and check history? This cannot be undone.

result.title: Check result
result.none: Run a check to compare the cluster with the active version.

summary.uncheckedNote: Resources that were not checked are not reported as matching.

reason.kind-unavailable: Resource type is not available in the cluster
reason.rules-version-mismatch: Created with different comparison rules: make a new version
reason.secret-unsupported: Secrets are not supported and are never read
reason.truncated: List was truncated by the size limit

caveat.hpa-unreadable: The HorizontalPodAutoscaler could not be read: replica counts were compared as is, so workloads under autoscaling may show false differences.

change.sensitive: Value of “{key}” {op} (the value is not shown)
change.sensitiveNoKey: A sensitive value {op} (the value is not shown)
change.sourceAudit: Applied from Kubron (audit record confirmed by cluster data), {time}

create.title: New baseline
create.name: Name
create.found: Will be recorded: {objects} resources, {hashed} sensitive values as hashes.
create.nothing: Nothing selected: there is nothing to record.
create.confirm: I understand that the current state is recorded as is, including deviations that already exist.
create.stale: The cluster changed after the preview. Preview again and confirm what you see.

version_dialog.title: New version
version_dialog.rulesChanged: The active version was recorded with different comparison rules; differences cannot be shown.
version_dialog.note: The new version becomes active. Exceptions of the current version are carried over.

versions.title: Versions
versions.author: Author
versions.confirmActive: Make version {seq} active? Later checks will compare against it.

exceptions.title: Exceptions
exceptions.none: No exceptions. An exception excludes a field from comparison for a resource or a whole resource type.
